context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 77 verified all traffic acquisition features: (1) SEO readiness - index.html has lang='pt', meta description, og:title, og:description, og:type, og:site_name, twitter:card, theme-color '#FFBE98'. (2) robots.txt - Cloudflare prepends managed content, our custom rules (Disallow /admin, /dashboard, /api/, /login, /auth/) are appended. (3) Sitemap - /api/sitemap.xml returns valid XML with static pages and public plans. (4) OG images - /api/og-image/{slug} returns PNG. (5) Share tracking - POST /api/track-share works for whatsapp/copy/native/link types. (6) Affiliate tracking - POST /api/affiliate-click works for all platforms. (7) Admin stats - /api/admin/share-stats, /api/admin/referral-stats, /api/admin/affiliate-stats all require admin auth and return expected data. SmartMap is lazy loaded in TravelPlanner.js. PublicPlan has share buttons (WhatsApp, copy, native). SEO.js dynamically sets OG meta tags. IfthenPay payment integration is MOCKED.
